book.name: Abosel
book.title: Abosel Yesuse okok dlasanin nakai i weng sangobe.

content: Fole Molta bib ye bisebe.
Ni inanoba alukum klayam watnoba ninin alim wat temoba naka maki baabeniba aaubil ele niniino Molta etabo gesiba wentenaboba
betan olo seli teniba heitdabeniba kima dlasiba bioba soko tlebianoa gildububeno kesoa i ase febeiba tefuboba
Fole imin anggameyo bola oleb te fakansea inabe as amun tem iwat bianea ulanea wat tenea Fole kweil wat antamasea

betano yo seli atemiba inabe e kweil wat antama bie kesoa i sinwalo obianiba Naka ele naka yemin nakabo, aantem daako mo kaaim blim otane memalo kukub klamin gode make baanea E kaaneko gene kesoa inabe antamabiebo gesib otane
Fole kweilone halele genea dabianea akil tem wat unea deibanea klayam bia
betano yo seli bianiba fumbianiba Situbanea kaanamabebo ge fumbiba e inamin namino mo omubaim blim kesoa i imin funaniba E godobo ge funasiobe.
Betano yo komoke niniino Fabliase ni dletnea tanoba e am tam aalaboba e kla kima bia amo asumatna blimanso dimo
Fabliase aye kweimo abua alo bela biam bia Fole atemnea kweile gabamon ut afunea beten kebanea ayam ane kesoa
nakaia unangai ginin gami maki wenteniba tlebiba klaye bisebe.
Fole monea Lom bib onsebe.

Siib make smik mako asu klaniba god dim omine Suse meme naka ten itabo geniba siib ele mukung mete dlasa geibbue Aleksandlia bib danea tetemea glole tleme kesoa denea Molta ye binabebua ni inaboba alimo asumatna blimano kesoa Deibe unomo genoba tanoba siib ele tem tam unom genaboba Fole ginin gami klayebei inamin namin homono oleb teniba ni oyib ole deibenoba
monoba Sailakyus bib ye bioba amo asumatna bliman ole
monoba Lisiam bib ye sobnoma bomanoa glole melen milim Saut da tenea fube dletnea beboba kwinoa siib tem wat aalabioba glole fuba obeb bebea bomanoa monoba Byutiolai bib ye unanoba siibe ye deibanoba
bibo yo seli nakaia unangai maki Yesuse bainobo gabibi ni baabeniba Ibo ni baka binibte gesiba baka bioba amo sebeno bliman ole deibenoba monoba Lom bibo kikib ye beboba

Lom bib seli maki Yesuse bainobo gabibi Folwali tebiobo gesiba wenteniba teniba maki Abiase imen wemin baan dimo waiseiba eka mak ile Stuamo Asumatnao baan dimo waisena bliba Fole monea yatemnea e Gode heitdabanea bobol ayam funane ole
ni monoba Lom bib ye temoba awa genalin nakai Fole klabutamo mo dabaib tam unim blim besa deibaniba baabaniba Am afet tam biebte ge baabaiba awa genalin nakae make kima bia

amo asumatnao bliman ole Fole baanea Yudai komokwali Lom bibo blibi tline gesea dli te misiba baabenea Nekwal ibo ne Yuda nib inamin namino kukub misiamo mo nabueim blimobe. Eka ne nib faninwali kukub osa mo ombiaim blim na otane Yelusalem bib seli klabuto besa ge nemeb teniba Lom bib sel isu ele daibbua

Lom teni ne inamin namin kukub misiamo nane biamobo geniba hembibo ne kukub misiamo mo naibiota natemin blim kesoa i baaniba Naka ele kukub misiamo mo naim blimobo, e mo kaanemene! Tileisanoba uneko geib otane

ninib atoi Yudai Yeye geniba i Lom teni wengo ombiabeib kesoa ne baabenia Ibo nemetniba monoba Lom teni komok sum esu temobta eta ne kukubo klaneko ge baabeibiobe. Ne inaibu otane nib atoi mo kot kebenimibabe.
Yo weng ota baabenano genita nganabeita teta wentiobe. Islel nakaia unangai Gode Dofakamin Nakae waisa blibo nele e tlebiobo gabi o dafa ota ne kweile sai ye getneibbiobo ge baabesea
i baabaniba Yudia seli keb kukub nabebo wengo futan temo ni mo baabeibta wentim blimobe. Eka Yudai naka maki mo tenibta baabeniba Fole kukub misiamo nabebo geibta ni mo wentim blimobo,
naka mak unang maki bib mak bib mak olo blibi obianiba Yesuse bainobo galin kukubo misiamobo gabib otane kobo keb bobol temo fumbebo ni baabenale ge baabaniba

am mako omakabaniba yo dim ota Gode wengo alebenale ge baabaibbua am olo tlamo tlebiba Gode nakaia unangai kimanamabe weng osa eka Yesuse bainobo galin kukubo Mosese buk temo dolanebu osa eka Gode weng omkeimalin nakai dolaibbu osa sbal manea aleyebea i Yesuse bainobo geine genea aleye bia boman tebo tlib biamo aleyebea bi kwin kwin bio otane
mak ita bainobo gabiba mak ile mo bainobo geim blimobe.

I bobol temo afet afet fumbianiba Fole deiba unom genamsiba Fole baabenea Gode Hobe Gode weng omkeimalin nakae niniino Aisaiae bain baabanea eka Aisaiae nib faninwali weng olo omkeimanea baabenea Gode Hobe baatnenea

content.text: Kobo moneba Yuda nakaia unanga isu unaneba baabeneba Ibo wengo ye wentemomabib otane o mitmakamo mo tekein kenomabibbabe. Ibo kino tememomabib otane inamin namino mo watemomabibbabe.

Niminbabe, nakaia unanga eli bobol temo agoko mo yemin blimobe. Eka i klango kweimiki datananiba i kino bina bliobe. I kino inamin namino watemniba eka i klango wengo mo wenteniba eka i bobol temo weng olo mitmakamo funaniba nesu tlib mole ne klaubeia ayam anomabib otane i mo inaim blim kesoa ne mo klaubeita ayam anim blimobo ge baanea dolanebiobo ge baabesebe.

content: Fole inanea imin baabenea Ibo tekein keine! Gode nibo hengmino temo biobo dotlanamino wengo Yudaba ita omfubenebio kesoa wentomabiobo ge baabesea
[Yudai i sinwalo alang weng baasese biniba Fole deiba onsiobe.]

Bifol asuo blimanso dimo Fole am mako temo aala bianea am olokiem olokiemo dimo emaye imeno webianea oleb te toubiam bia nakaia unangai teniba e am tam tlebiba Klayam nata tlibo? ge oye bianea bobol ayam bianea
Gode wengo sbal manea omkeima bianea Gode nakaia unangai kimanin kukub osa eka Sume Yesus Klaiste dowan weng osa aleye monseo naka maki watanamino blimobe. E sbal manea omkaye monsebe.
